events.text: Bank Central Asia's 2025 Sustainability Report lists Scope 1 emissions of 12,345 tCO2e.
Bank Central Asia's 2025 Sustainability Report reports renewable energy at 45%.
Bank Central Asia's 2025 Sustainability Report reports women holding 33% of board seats and 28% of management positions.
Bank Central Asia's 2025 Sustainability Report reports 0 workplace fatalities.
Bank Central Asia's 2023 Sustainability Report states operational GHG emissions totaled 309,024 tCO2 eq, comprising Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions.
Bank Central Asia's 2023 Sustainability Report states all employees received sustainable-finance training and financial-literacy programs reached 296,022 participants.

BCA's Sustainable Finance Framework states its report will outline the sector-wise distribution of the green financing portion, reporting key sectors such as renewable energy, sustainable natural resources & land use, sustainable transport, and green buildings.

Suspicious activity was detected in the customer fund account (RDN) of PT Panca Global Sekuritas at Bank Central Asia (BCA) on Tuesday, September 9, 2025, with multiple fund withdrawals in a short period of time.
Bank Central Asia's 2025 sustainability report states Scope 1 emissions of 12,345 tCO2e, Scope 2 emissions of 8,765 tCO2e, and Scope 3 emissions of 45,678 tCO2e.
Bank Central Asia's 2025 sustainability report reports 33% women on the board, 28% women in management, and 0 workplace fatalities.
In BCA's 2023 sustainability performance, sustainable financing reached Rp202.6 trillion and 24.8% of the total portfolio.
BCA's Audit Committee meetings are held at least 4 times a year, as stipulated in Board of Commissioners Decree No. 142/SK/KOM/2022 dated 22 August 2022 concerning the Audit Committee Charter.
BCA's 2023 sustainability report states sustainable financing reached Rp202.6 trillion, representing 24.8% of the total portfolio.

PT Bank Central Asia Tbk's Sustainable Finance Framework (final version, file dated 20260129) states the report will outline the sector-wise distribution of the green financing portion, covering key sectors such as renewable energy, sustainable natural resources & land use, sustainable transport, and green buildings.

OJK dikenakan sanksi administrasi berupa denda Rp100.000.000 terhadap PT Bank Central Asia Tbk selaku Bank Kustodian karena melanggar Pasal 8 ayat (1) dan Pasal 8 ayat (3) POJK Nomor 23/POJK.04/2016, dalam keterangan resmi bertanggal 13/10/2023.
